LESSON: Usage-format helpers that Node imports as `.ts` must stay free of extensionless local imports; put locale phrases they emit in i18n as well so UI strings are not English-only in the formatter.

dispatchContext.rulesText:
- In verification scripts and tests that create temp dirs, use /tmp explicitly (mktemp -d /tmp/x.XXXXXX, or TMPDIR=/tmp): the writer sandbox denies mkdtemp in the system TMPDIR under /var/folders. Keep PM-written check scripts in /tmp/<name>/ (the guard blocks .mjs under .agents/).
- In a folder without git (live-folder mode), never put a task's expected_outputs or owns_paths under .bb/ (chat folders): the live snapshot skips .bb, so a file written there is never counted as produced and the task blocks as missing expected_outputs. Put task deliverables in a project folder such as docs/ or reports/.
- When generating a site screen by screen, pass the previous screen to the generator and tell it which next screen of the same site it is producing, so the screens read as one coherent site.
- Правя тестовый файл из owns_paths, меняй только ожидаемые значения внутри существующих строгих assert (deepEqual/equal) и добавляй новые проверки рядом — не удаляй строки assert и не ослабляй строгую проверку до assert.ok/includes/truthiness; перед ответом перечитай свой diff по тестам и верни всё, что стало слабее: test_fit помечает это как сломанную проверку, и попытки сгорают до лимита.
- For a BB ACP provider, check every launch spec and output shape against BB's own bridge code before shipping: permission flags are inserted at permissionCli.insertAfterArgs (default 0, so a /bin/sh -c wrapper needs insertAfterArgs after its args), and agent_message_chunk keeps only text (image blocks are dropped; show pictures as Markdown ![alt](workspace-relative path)).
- In muse-ai-connector, every check script or test that imports bridge/ modules must set MUSE_BRIDGE_HOME to a fresh mkdtemp under /tmp before the import; never let a check write into the real ~/.muse-bridge (accounts, cookies, cache).
- In BB plugin CSS never derive paddings or gaps from var(--spacing): BB runs Tailwind v4 where --spacing is 4px. Define the plugin's own spacing tokens with concrete px values (gap 16, page padding 24, card padding 20) and give plugin UI plans a spacing table plus ASCII mocks for every page.

dispatchContext.pmReadContext: This task implements re-login functionality for existing Muse accounts directly from the Muse UI panel, propagating the refreshed session cookies across all connected machines. In bin/musebridge.mjs, a new CLI subcommand `accounts login <id>` must be added to the HELP text and routed to `cmdAccountsLogin`. For an unknown account id, it must exit with status 2 and print 'Unknown account: <id>'. For valid accounts, `cmdAccountsLogin` must execute a strict sequence: open a headed session with `withSession({ accountId, headless: false })`, wait for sign-in via `session.waitForSignIn()`, update account status with `setStatus`, export cookies via `exportAccountCookies(session, id)`, and push cookies via `pushAfterCookies(id)`. At the RPC layer, host.ts must expose `reloginAccount {id}` running `musebridge accounts login <id>`, and server.ts must expose `reloginAccount {hostId, id}` which runs the host method and then calls `syncFrom(hostId, id, entries)` specifically for that account. Additionally, provider hints in server.ts must be updated to refer to the Muse panel and eliminate mentions of 'Settings → Plugins → Muse'. In the frontend (app.tsx / i18n.ts), each account card must place 'Войти заново' as its first action, styled with an accent when the account is signed out on any machine, and display a result summary showing successful sync counts and naming failed machines. Finally, the project version must be bumped to 0.3.17 across version.ts, package.json, and package-lock.json, and all verification tests (including tests/account-relogin.test.mjs and /tmp/muse-relogin/check.mjs) must pass.
